title: 第198章  只能以情动之
slug: 凡人从拔刀三十万次开始
content_zh:
陈时安将目光看向了侯方和白霜，“侯大哥，你俩的喜事什么时候办？”
白霜顿时红了脸，低下了头，娇羞不已。
侯家老太太说话了，“白霜这孩子讨喜，我希望他们的喜事越早越好。”
侯方笑道：“娘，再早也得让我先把伤养好吧，我总不能顶着一身的伤当新郎官。”
白霜偷偷地在侯方的腰间掐了一把，更是羞涩不已。
看到侯方一家其乐融融，陈时安心中大生一口气的同时，也是替侯方感到高兴。
…………
回到猎妖营，陈时安第一时间找到了叶西城。
“叶统领，我手底下现在已经有了三个什长，但人员却不过三十，得进行一定的补充。”
叶西城稍作犹豫，“我和千统领商量一下，从她那边给你调拨一些人手过去。”
陈时安摇了摇头，“咱们猎妖营的架构刚刚稳定，就不要再去折腾了，还是我自己招募吧。”
叶西城思虑片刻，“可以，只不过，不能像先前那般大张旗鼓，毕竟，你招募的人并不太多。”
陈时安微微一笑，“统领，我可以不大张旗鼓的以猎妖营的名义招募人手，只不过，我招募的人手可能不会太少。”
叶西城微皱起眉头，“即便是三个什，满编也才三十三号人，你手底下，加上朱能、皮猴和杜刚，已经有了二十八人，即便招，也只招五六人而已。”
陈时安笑容不减，“正常的什，的确是十一人满编。
但是，我手底下的这几个什，可不一样，皮侯和杜刚都已经是入品武者，自然不能以正常什长对待。”
叶西城稍作沉默，“你打算招多少人？”
陈时安做出一副思索模样，约莫六息后，沉声说道：“也不多，凑齐六十人吧。”
叶西城眉头一皱，正要说话，陈时安跟了一句，“原本，我打算让皮侯和杜刚一人招募四五十位属下。
但想想，他们虽然是入品武者，但在训练管理队伍上，还是生手，就少招募一些。”

叶西城连忙回应，“好吧，就依你说的，给你六十人的编制。”
“多谢叶统领。”陈时安满脸笑容地拱手道谢。
叶西城跟了一句，“扩招的事情，我同意了还不能作数。我得向城主禀报，经由城主点头之后，你才能够开始着手去做。”
陈时安嗯了一声。
他很清楚，这个时候，即便自己提出再过分的要求，项楚雄都会答应下来。
叶西城的请示，不过是走个流程和过场而已。
果不其然，第二日，叶西城便派人传话过来，让陈时安自己负责招募的事宜。
陈时安将扩招的事情向皮侯、杜刚、朱能三人传达之后，便离开了城卫营，找到了铁牛。
“王天野这件事情，你办得不错。”陈时安笑声表扬。
铁牛拱了拱手，“我经营十余年的情报网，若是连这点事情都办不妥当，岂不是太令陈统领失望。”
陈时安微微一笑，将一个瓷瓶递向了铁牛。
铁牛接过瓷瓶，将瓶塞
因为，瓷瓶里头装着五枚洗髓丹。
“陈统领，这么多洗髓丹，你现在就给我？”铁牛明显还有些不相信。
陈时安笑容不减，“疑人不用，用人不疑。
我既然选中了你，自然就相信你。
你若是能够早些洗髓伐骨，对你自然是有天大的好处，也同样能为我办更多更大的事情。”
“多谢陈统领！”铁牛再次拱手，满眼感激。
陈时安点了点头，“你放心，用不了多久，你就不用再遮头遮脸，可以堂堂正正地回到猎妖营。”
铁牛明显一怔，继而再次拱手道谢，脸上尽是激动的表情。

他在猎妖营待了十几年，对猎妖营有着深厚的感情。
同时，也有深深的不甘。
听闻还有机会重回猎妖营，怎能不激动。
陈时安接着问道：“先前那些猎妖营的老兄弟，在你被押入匠作坊的时候，他们也受到了清洗，要么被处死，要么被关入大牢，要么被赶出了猎妖营。
而其中，被赶出猎妖营的人最多，你有没有办法找到他们？”
铁牛快速回应，“没问题。”
继而疑惑地问道：“统领想要做什么？”
陈时安眼皮轻抬，“这些老兄弟一个个身经百战，对猎妖营忠心耿耿，曾经对城寨做出过莫大贡献，但却成了项楚雄和付统领权力斗争的牺牲品，未免太过可惜。
我有计划，将他们重新召回猎妖营。”
闻言，铁牛脸上现出了惊喜之色，“这些人，我大多都认识，都是一些有情有义的铁血汉子，若是统领能够让他们重回猎妖营，他们必定会感激涕零，誓死效忠。”
陈时安嗯了一声，“这件事情，我会竭尽全力。只不过，还得需要你来牵线。
毕竟，你和他们更熟悉，他们也更加信任你，你出面的话，会容易很多。”
铁牛摇了摇头，“这些兄弟对猎妖营感情很深，以身在猎妖营为荣。
身上的猎妖营制服被扒掉，横刀被收缴，这对他们而言，是奇耻大辱，是一辈子的痛。
而且，我可以肯定，他们现在的处境极其不妙，离开了猎妖营，生活必定困顿，还要遭受身周人的白眼。
若是统领能够让他们重回猎妖营，他们必定会立马答应，无需我出面。”
陈时安摇了摇头，“正因为如此，才需要你出面。
这些都是血性汉子，铮铮铁骨，不能以利诱，只能以情动。”
铁牛眼神闪动，继而朝着陈时安恭恭敬敬地弯腰行礼，“统领放心，我会在最短的时间之内，把他们都给找齐。”
陈时安嗯了一声，“不过，你得和他们事先说好，我会想办法先把他们带回猎妖营。

只不过，他们暂时还需要隐藏真实身份。”
铁牛沉声回应，“这个不成问题，能够重回猎妖营，他们求之不得，暂时不能够透露真实身份，不过是小事一桩。”
陈时安稍作思索，“既如此，我便给你六天的时间，把人手都召集起来。
铁牛摇了摇头，“哪里用得了六天，三天就够！”
content_en:
Chen Shi'an looked at Hou Fang and Bai Shuang, "Brother Hou, when will your wedding be held?"
Bai Shuang immediately blushed and lowered her head, feeling shy.
The old lady of the Hou family spoke, "Bai Shuang is a delightful child. I hope their happy event will happen as soon as possible."
Hou Fang smiled and said: "Mom, no matter how early it is, you have to let me recover from my injuries. I can't be the groom's official with all my injuries."
Bai Shuang secretly pinched Hou Fang's waist, feeling even more shy.
Seeing Hou Fang's family enjoying themselves happily, Chen Shi'an breathed a sigh of relief and was also happy for Hou Fang.
…………
Back at the demon hunting camp, Chen Shian immediately found Ye Xicheng.
"Commander Ye, I now have three chiefs under my command, but the number of personnel is only thirty, so we need to make some supplements."
Ye Xicheng hesitated for a moment, "I will discuss with Commander Qian and send you some manpower from her side."
Chen Shi'an shook his head, "The structure of our demon hunting camp has just been stabilized, so don't bother anymore. I'll recruit it myself."
Ye Xicheng thought for a moment and said, "Okay, but you can't do it with as much fanfare as before. After all, you don't recruit many people."
Chen Shi'an smiled slightly, "Commander, I can recruit people in the name of the Demon Hunting Battalion without much fanfare, but the number of people I recruit may not be too few."
Ye Xicheng frowned slightly, "Even if there are three people, there are only thirty-three people in the full staff. Including Zhu Neng, Pi Hou and Du Gang, you already have twenty-eight people. Even if you recruit, you will only recruit five or six people."
Chen Shi'an's smile continued, "It's normal, it's indeed a full complement of eleven people.
However, these weapons under my control are different. Pihou and Du Gang are already advanced warriors, so naturally they cannot be treated with normal skills. "
Ye Xicheng was silent for a moment, "How many people do you plan to recruit?"
Chen Shi'an looked like he was thinking, and after about six breaths, he said in a deep voice: "There aren't many, let's gather 60 people."
Ye Xicheng frowned and was about to speak when Chen Shi'an followed, "Originally, I planned to let Pihou and Du Gang recruit forty or fifty subordinates alone.
But think about it, although they are high-level warriors, they are still novices in training and managing the team, so they should recruit less. "
Ye Xicheng responded quickly, "Okay, as you said, I will give you an establishment of sixty people."
"Thank you, Commander Ye." Chen Shi'an thanked him with a smile on his face.
Ye Xicheng followed, "As for the expansion of enrollment, I can't count on it yet. I have to report it to the city lord. Only after the city lord nods, can you start to do it."
Chen Shi'an hummed.
He knew very well that at this time, no matter how excessive his request was, Xiang Chuxiong would agree to it.
Ye Xicheng's request for instructions was just a formality and formality.
Sure enough, the next day, Ye Xicheng sent someone to send a message and asked Chen Shi'an to take charge of the recruitment.
After Chen Shi'an informed Pi Hou, Du Gang, and Zhu Neng about the enrollment expansion, he left the city guard camp and found Tieniu.
"Wang Tianye, you did a good job on this matter." Chen Shi'an praised with a smile.
Tieniu cupped his hand and said, "I have been running an intelligence network for more than ten years. If it can't even handle this matter properly, wouldn't it be a huge disappointment to Commander Chen?"
Chen Shi'an smiled slightly and handed a porcelain bottle to Tieniu.
Tieniu took the porcelain bottle and corked it
Because there are five marrow-cleansing pills in the porcelain bottle.
"Commander Chen, are you going to give me these marrow-cleansing pills now?" Tieniu obviously still didn't believe it.
Chen Shi'an's smile did not diminish, "Don't use the people you doubt, and don't doubt the people you employ.
Since I have chosen you, I naturally believe in you.
If you could cleanse the marrow and cut off the bones earlier, it would be of great benefit to you, and you could also do more and bigger things for me. "
"Thank you, Commander Chen!" Tieniu handed over his hand again, his eyes filled with gratitude.
Chen Shi'an nodded, "Don't worry, it won't be long before you no longer have to cover your head and face, and you can return to the demon hunting camp with dignity. "
Tieniu was obviously startled, and then he handed over his hand and thanked him again, with an excited expression on his face.
He has stayed in the monster hunting camp for more than ten years and has deep feelings for the monster hunting camp.
At the same time, there is also deep reluctance.
How could I not be excited when I heard that there was still a chance to return to the demon hunting camp.
Chen Shi'an then asked: "Those old brothers from the demon hunting camp before were also purged when you were taken into the craftsman's workshop. They were either executed, imprisoned, or kicked out of the demon hunting camp.
Among them, the most people have been kicked out of the demon hunting camp. Is there any way you can find them? "
Tieniu responded quickly, “No problem. "
Then he asked doubtfully: "What does the commander want to do? "
Chen Shi'an raised his eyelids slightly, "These old brothers have experienced hundreds of battles and are loyal to the demon hunting camp. They have made great contributions to the city, but they have become victims of the power struggle between Xiang Chuxiong and Commander Fu. It is a pity.
I have a plan to bring them back to the demon hunting camp. "
Hearing this, a look of surprise appeared on Tieniu's face, "I know most of these people. They are all loyal and loyal men. If the commander can let them return to the demon hunting camp, they will definitely shed tears of gratitude and swear loyalty to the death. "
Chen Shi'an hummed, "I will do my best on this matter. However, I still need you to pull the strings.
After all, you are more familiar with them and they trust you more. It will be much easier for you to come forward. "
Tieniu shook his head, "These brothers have deep feelings for the Demon Hunting Camp and are proud to be in the Demon Hunting Camp.
Their demon hunting camp uniforms were stripped off and their swords were confiscated. This was a great shame and humiliation for them, and a lifetime of pain.
Moreover, I am certain that their current situation is extremely bad. After leaving the demon hunting camp, their lives will be difficult and they will suffer from the eyes of the people around them.
If the commander can allow them to return to the demon hunting camp, they will definitely agree immediately without my intervention. "
Chen Shi'an shook his head, "That's why you need to come forward.
These are bloody men, strong-willed and unyielding. They cannot be lured with profit, but can only be moved by emotion. "
Tieniu's eyes flashed, and then he bowed and saluted respectfully towards Chen Shi'an, "Don't worry, Commander, I will find them all in the shortest possible time. "
Chen Shi'an hummed, "However, you have to agree with them in advance that I will find a way to bring them back to the demon hunting camp first.
However, they still need to hide their true identities for the time being. "
Tieniu responded in a deep voice, "This is not a problem. Being able to return to the demon hunting camp is what they want. They cannot reveal their true identity for the time being, but it is just a trivial matter. "
Chen Shi'an thought for a moment, "In that case, I will give you six days to gather all the people.
Tieniu shook his head, "Six days are not needed, three days are enough!"
